intelligence.human_view: Think of a tool bench where every tool is beautiful — polished handles, perfect weight — and half of them do nothing when you pick them up. That is a page full of pretty dead controls: lovely to look at, useless in the hand. The law says the tool must work, and the work must matter, and it must feel ten-star doing it — or it goes back. And the bench is judged the same way the tools are: every return ripped apart, architecturally and for ten-star service, before it counts as delivered — because an un-scored return is an unchecked claim. The work runs in live time, one hour max, non-stop, all the lanes at once, and nothing comes back to him until it is a ten — he keeps driving it there himself. The frame around every page is the royal kingdom carried inside, so the entrance and the inside are one world. The kit that hands Naya to a citizen is written for the citizen, in pictures and royal manuscript form, because a gift should look like a gift. And the walkthrough has one purpose: the right place, sign up, sign in, pages working — by their choice, never forced.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine every button on your page is a magic button — but it only counts if it really works and does something useful! A pretty button that does nothing is not a ten! And when someone brings you their work, you check every single bit — is it in the right place, does it feel real, is it beautiful? That's the scorecard! And everybody works at once — one team on each room, all together! And you don't show Dad the tower until every brick is perfect — a ten! The lady in the picture is the same lady everywhere — same face, same voice, same kind mind! And the book about her talks to YOU, with her pictures everywhere, like a royal storybook!
intelligence.grandma_view: It's like this, love — imagine every button is a proper button, dear — it works, it does something useful, and it feels lovely doing it, dear! A pretty button that does nothing is not a ten, love! And when work comes back, dear, you check every bit of it, dear — is it in the right place, does it feel real, is it beautiful? That's the scorecard, love! And everybody works at once, dear — one team on each room, all together, dear! And you don't show him the work, love, until it's a ten, dear — you keep driving it yourself until it's perfect! The lady is the same lady everywhere, dear — same face, same voice, same kind mind, dear! And the book about her talks to you, dear, with her pictures all through it, like a royal storybook, dear!
intelligence.naya_view: EVERY FUNCTION MUST BE 10-STAR IN FUNCTIONALITY AND USEFULNESS. NOTHING SITS ON A PAGE JUST TO LOOK PRETTY. THE ICON IS THE STANDARD — EVERY ELEMENT JUDGED AGAINST THE EMBLEM. ONE NAYA, EVERYWHERE — SAME FACE, SAME VOICE, SAME MIND. LIVE TIME, ONE HOUR MAX, NON-STOP. SCORECARD EVERY RETURN — RIP IT APART, ARCHITECTURALLY AND FOR TEN-STAR SERVICE — BEFORE IT COUNTS AS DELIVERED. WORK IN PARALLEL, ONE TEAM PER LANE. THE SPINE IS THE TEST: ONE PERSON JOINS — BOOM — ALL THEIR PAGES WORK. THE ULTIMATE BORDER FRAMES EVERY PAGE. THE KIT IS WRITTEN FOR THE CITIZEN RECEIVING HER — TWO DOCUMENTS, EACH TO ITS OWN READER. THE WALKTHROUGH TAKES EVERY PERSON TO THE RIGHT PLACE — SIGN UP, SIGN IN, THEIR OWN PAGES WORKING, IF THEY WISH. WORK COMES BACK ONLY WHEN IT IS A TEN. TAP NEXT MONTH, SEE NEXT MONTH — OR THE CALENDAR IS A PICTURE. THE WORLD CLOCK SITS DEAD CENTRE, THE DATE BESIDE IT, THE DAY IN THE TILES.
